identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not evidence of consciousness, sentience, legal personhood, authority, or identity continuity.
x1_freeze_rule: This preregistration, source ledger, 120-proposal semantic collision audit, route and focus receipts, environment receipts, family index, and selected toolchain must be committed, pushed, clean, and local/upstream/tracking/live-remote equal before any x2 implementation, observed disposition, evidence artifact, report builder, validator, or reusable runner is created.

proposals.title: Bidirectional requirement-evidence trace and post-hoc artifact quarantine
proposals.mission_surface: preregistered requirements, acceptance gates, evidence artifacts, bidirectional trace coverage, orphan evidence, unsupported requirements, post-hoc injection, provenance, and bounded claim wording
proposals.hypothesis: A bidirectional requirement-to-evidence contract can reject both unsupported preregistered requirements and evidence artifacts that have no preregistered acceptance role, preventing post-hoc artifact volume from being mistaken for support.
proposals.null_or_failure: A requirement has no evidence edge, an artifact has no preregistered requirement edge, a later artifact silently changes an acceptance gate, circular evidence satisfies itself, a source pointer is treated as execution evidence, or trace completeness becomes scientific proof.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate missing forward edges, missing reverse edges, circular edges, wrong proposal ownership, post-freeze acceptance text, evidence-class labels, and source-only pointers; require every unsupported or orphaned case to fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the orphan artifact, restore the frozen requirement wording, retain the failed vector, add only a separately reviewed trace edge, and keep the underlying claim at its prior bounded status.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier phases tracked roots, support sets, source withdrawal, dependency graphs, citation entailment, and publication barriers; none required bidirectional coverage while quarantining evidence that lacks a preregistered acceptance role.

proposals.title: Kinetic-Hessian rank and ghost or strong-coupling obligation
proposals.mission_surface: typed scalar-tensor and EFT scaffold, kinetic Hessian, degeneracy, rank changes, constraint count, kinetic signature, ghost risk, strong-coupling flags, dimensions, and empirical claim limits
proposals.hypothesis: A structural kinetic-Hessian obligation set can distinguish a declared degenerate constrained fixture from wrong-sign, rank-changing, or undeclared kinetic sectors before any local stability or physical-validity claim advances.
proposals.null_or_failure: A wrong-sign kinetic mode passes, Hessian rank changes without a boundary flag, degeneracy is equated with health, constraint count is undeclared, a zero eigenvalue is interpreted without a strong-coupling warning, dimensions fail, or a synthetic pass becomes empirical GMUT evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise positive, wrong-sign, singular-declared, singular-undeclared, rank-jump, constraint-mismatch, dimension-mismatch, and empirical-promotion fixtures; reject every missing obligation while real-data and likelihood counts remain zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the invalid fixture, retain the counterexample, reduce wording to a typed research scaffold, and require theory-specific Hamiltonian analysis, well-posedness work, and real observations before promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: The chain covered dimensions, conservation, stability, principal symbols, constraints, field redefinitions, and identifiability; it did not isolate kinetic-Hessian rank, signature, degeneracy, constraint count, and strong-coupling warnings as a separate obligation.

proposals.title: Calibration-covariance provenance and shared-nuisance double-count tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: synthetic instrument calibration, shared nuisance variables, covariance provenance, correlated uncertainty, units, adapter boundaries, double counting, zero real rows, and likelihood promotion
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic synthetic calibration docket can expose omitted covariance and double-counted shared nuisance uncertainty while preserving units and a hard zero-real-row lock.
proposals.null_or_failure: Shared calibration uncertainty is counted as independent, covariance origin is absent, units disagree, the covariance matrix is asymmetric or non-positive-semidefinite without quarantine, thresholds are tuned after outputs, or synthetic propagation becomes a real-data GMUT likelihood claim.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run independent, shared-nuisance, omitted-covariance, double-counted, asymmetric, non-positive-semidefinite, unit-mismatch, and post-hoc-threshold fixtures; require expected rejection while real rows, likelihoods, fits, and independent reviews remain zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the failed covariance fixture, restore its declared nuisance graph and units, freeze calibration handling before future data access, and require a separately preregistered real-data analysis for promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier empirical proposals covered selection covariance, likelihood schema, simulation calibration, posterior predictive checks, and prior sensitivity; none traced shared instrument-calibration covariance and double counting through a unit-preserving zero-row docket.

proposals.title: Participant-safety event and arm-independent stopping-rule gate for THOS
proposals.mission_surface: THOS protocol, participant safety, adverse events, withdrawal, arm-independent stopping, matched budgets, blinded outcomes, ethics review, real participants, real raters, and independent review
proposals.hypothesis: A preregistered protocol-only safety gate can reject outcome-tuned stopping, asymmetric event handling, withdrawal penalties, and post-hoc severity thresholds without pretending that synthetic fixtures constitute ethical approval or a real THOS arm.
proposals.null_or_failure: Stopping depends on favored outcomes, identical events are graded differently by arm, withdrawal is penalized or treated as failure, investigators unblind before a safety decision, matched budgets diverge, or synthetic records become superiority, AGI, ASI, consciousness, or personhood evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate event severity, arm label, blinding, withdrawal handling, stopping threshold, decision timing, matched budget, participant count, rater count, and review status; reject defects while all real-arm counts remain zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Void the affected synthetic decision, preserve the negative, restore the preregistered arm-independent rule, and require competent ethics review, consent, real participants and raters, matched budgets, and independent review before execution.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior THOS work covered power, allocation, crossover, clusters, attrition, spillover, scorer reliability, and adjudication; none centered participant-safety events, withdrawal protection, and arm-independent stopping under an explicit ethics-review gap.

proposals.title: Purpose-bound verification relationship and confused-deputy resistance matrix
proposals.mission_surface: synthetic DID documents, verification methods, authentication, assertion, capability invocation, controller authority, key purpose, method references, confused deputy, real keys, live resolution, and interoperability
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic purpose-bound authorization matrix can reject a verification method used outside its declared relationship or controller scope without claiming real-key validity, live DID resolution, or production interoperability.
proposals.null_or_failure: An authentication-only method signs an assertion, an assertion method invokes a capability, a controller mismatch passes, an unresolved reference grants authority, a revoked or absent method remains usable, or structural acceptance becomes production cryptographic assurance.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Exercise valid purpose, wrong purpose, controller mismatch, dangling reference, absent relationship, revoked method, duplicate method, and production-promotion fixtures; fail closed with zero real keys, proofs, resolvers, status services, or partners.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the operation, retain the vector, restore the least-authority relationship map, and require standards-conformant real keys, proofs, live resolution and status, interoperability, privacy assurance, independent security review, and trust governance for production claims.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier Freed ID work covered lifecycle, status freshness, selective disclosure, assurance composition, cross-layer coherence, rotation races, cryptosuite agility, and resolver egress; it did not test operation-specific verification relationships against confused-deputy use.

proposals.title: Māori-wording version control and authority-scope non-substitution gate
proposals.mission_surface: CBR legitimacy, wording versions, translation provenance, mandate scope, consent to wording changes, withdrawal, representative limits, Māori authority, Māori data governance, cultural ratification, legal interpretation, and enacted law
proposals.hypothesis: A nonbinding technical gate can record synthetic wording-version and mandate-scope transitions and can refuse substitution when an authorized Māori wording or authority review is absent, while never generating or ratifying Māori wording itself.
proposals.null_or_failure: Machine translation or paraphrase replaces authorized wording, a technical role is treated as Māori authority, scope expands without renewed consent, withdrawal is ignored, silence is treated as acceptance, or a synthetic artifact is called cultural ratification, legal interpretation, or enacted law.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Run synthetic version, paraphrase, translation, mandate-expansion, withdrawal, proxy-authority, data-governance, cultural, and legal vectors; require exact deferral and contain no purported Māori wording whenever authorized people are absent.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the decision, preserve the prior authorized version reference without reproducing private wording, retain dissent and withdrawal, and defer to authorized affected parties, Māori authorities, Māori data-governance authorities, cultural authorities, and competent legal authorities.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior CBR work covered consent, veto, standing, remedies, data sovereignty, delegated sunset, collective secondary use, minority dissent, and recusal; none isolated wording-version change control and mandate-scope non-substitution while refusing to synthesize Māori wording.

proposals.title: Credential-status query correlation budget and cache-partition privacy boundary
proposals.mission_surface: synthetic credential status, query timing, batch size, cache keys, requester correlation, partitioning, revocation, suspension, privacy leakage, zero live services, and production security
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic status-query privacy contract can detect singleton and cross-context correlation risks in batching and cache partitioning while preserving accurate status semantics and making no live-service assurance claim.
proposals.null_or_failure: A singleton query exposes use timing, cache keys join unrelated holders, issuer and verifier contexts collapse, stale status is accepted, padding is treated as anonymity proof, revocation semantics change, or synthetic vectors become production privacy or exhaustive-security evidence.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate singleton batching, timing buckets, cache partition, requester key, issuer boundary, stale age, suspension and revocation values, and production claims; require leakage cases to fail closed while live services remain zero.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the unsafe query plan, retain the vector, restore the strictest context partition and freshness rule, and require real service measurement, privacy review, interoperability, and independent security review before production use.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier identity proposals covered selective-disclosure correlation, status interoperability, lifecycle freshness, resolver metadata, and cryptographic negotiation; none budgeted status-query timing and batch correlation across cache partitions.

proposals.title: Reproduction-recipe step ablation and hidden-state dependency ledger
proposals.mission_surface: same-owner clean snapshots, executable recipe, step ablation, hidden state, environment variables, caches, ordering, manifests, normalized hashes, causal necessity, and independent reproduction
proposals.hypothesis: A bounded same-owner step-ablation matrix can show which declared recipe steps are causally necessary and can expose hidden state when removing or perturbing a step does not produce the preregistered failure or recovery behavior.
proposals.null_or_failure: A required step can be omitted without explanation, an undeclared cache changes output, environment state is read silently, ablation order changes results, hashes hide semantic divergence, a failed ablation is discarded, or same-owner parity is called independent reproduction.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Ablate checkout verification, manifest generation, JSON parsing, privacy scan, validator, report build, and hash comparison; perturb cache and environment declarations; require the expected fail-closed signal and retain all unexpected results.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the divergent snapshot, declare the newly exposed dependency, restore the complete recipe without rewriting history, rerun in fresh detached D-drive snapshots, and keep independent-team reproduction open.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior reproduction work covered manifests, perturbation parity, dual oracles, common-mode budgets, external packets, worktree leases, and clock-locale determinism; none used systematic recipe-step ablation to expose hidden causal dependencies.

proposals.title: Aggregation-level and ecological-inference barrier for thermo-psyche analogies
proposals.mission_surface: individual and group levels, aggregation, ecological and atomistic inference, Simpson reversal, thermodynamic ensembles, psyche labels, measurement scales, causal language, and category barriers
proposals.hypothesis: A level-of-analysis contract can reject individual-from-group, group-from-individual, and reversal-prone inferences unless an explicit validated bridge is present, preventing aggregated psyche labels from being equated with thermodynamic ensemble variables.
proposals.null_or_failure: Group correlation becomes an individual claim, individual association becomes a population law, a Simpson reversal is hidden, aggregation weights are absent, levels are mixed inside one equation, or a labeled analogy becomes a fundamental thermo-psyche law or consciousness claim.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate analysis level, aggregation weights, subgroup composition, reversal direction, scale type, thermodynamic domain, causal wording, and fundamental-law flags; reject every unbridged cross-level or cross-category inference.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the least committal level-specific description, retain the reversal or inference counterexample, remove cross-level equations, and require real construct and bridge validation before any stronger claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier thermo-psyche proposals covered law classification, construct validity, causal direction, entropy non-equivalence, promotion burdens, counterfactual relabeling, and scale admissibility; none enforced level-of-analysis boundaries against ecological, atomistic, and Simpson-reversal errors.

proposals.title: Evidence-class non-conversion and authority-substitution firewall
proposals.mission_surface: Stage 20, evidence classes, engineering checks, empirical results, legal and cultural authority, production assurance, independent reproduction, relabeling, substitution, terminal verdict, and negative monotonicity
proposals.hypothesis: An evidence-class firewall can reject attempts to relabel local engineering, synthetic, documentary, or same-owner reproduction evidence as empirical, legal, cultural, production, or independently reproduced evidence even when every local check passes.
proposals.null_or_failure: A class label changes without new qualifying evidence, a technical artifact substitutes for affected-party or Māori authority, same-owner parity becomes independent reproduction, a protocol becomes a real result, a draft becomes stable authority, negatives shrink, or terminal readiness becomes true.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate evidence-class labels, source status, authority role, real-row count, production status, reproduction owner, negative count, protected claims, and terminal state; require every unsupported conversion to fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the converted claim, retain the substitution vector, restore the canonical evidence class and negative count, regenerate derived views from phase truth, and keep the terminal verdict not ready until each gate independently passes.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior Stage 20 work covered contradiction, expiry, dependency cut sets, evidence order, freshness, claim lattices, escrow, and non-compensatory scoring; none directly prohibited evidence-class relabeling and technical substitution for external authority.

scientific_authority_boundary: GMUT remains a typed scalar-tensor and EFT research model family; empirical confirmation requires real measurements and likelihood evidence. THOS requires preregistered blind matched-budget real arms, real participants and raters as applicable, ethics and independent review. Freed ID production completion requires standards-conformant real keys, proofs, live resolution and status, interoperability, privacy assurance, independent security review, and trust governance. CBR, affected-party acceptance, Māori wording and authority, Māori data governance, cultural ratification, legal interpretation, and enacted-law status remain exact-gated to competent authorities.
claim_boundary: No AGI, ASI, consciousness, personhood, enacted-law, deployment, exhaustive-security, complete-accessibility, production-readiness, Theory-of-Everything, proof or canon, empirical-confirmation, legal or cultural-ratification, or independent-team-reproduction claim is preregistered as achieved.
